consent.title: Your privacy
consent.description: We use cookies and similar technologies that the website needs to work (they store your choice and the colour scheme). Only with your consent do we also use Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics (statistics); data may then be transferred to Google in the USA. You can change your choice at any time under "Cookie settings" at the bottom of every page.
consent.settingsIntro: Choose what you allow. Necessary storage only keeps your choice and the colour scheme. Details are on the privacy page.

necessary.title: Necessary
necessary.description: Stores your consent choice and, when you pick one at the top, your colour scheme. Always active, since without it we could not remember a "no".

statistics.title: Statistics
statistics.description: Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics measure how the site is used (pages, clicks), pseudonymously and without advertising.
